scope: Protocol pair/operation casualty replacement eligibility, not full pair timing or physical acceptance
finding: OperationStep already treats fleeing as a temporary native owner, but RebalanceRoles candidate predicate omitted fleeing. A combat-effective fleeing actor could keep occupying or re-entering the desired active roster while the executor correctly refused it, starving an eligible replacement.
implementation: Use !fleeing in the existing actor-eligibility predicate for candidate selection and the unchanged atomic roster-publication recheck. Do not change desired count, original operation generation/deadline, native morale/flight, medical queues or movement controllers. Existing CombatPairsPublish retains living out-of-scope identity separately.
limits: No historical screenshot or failure is attributed solely to this omission
No physical casualty/flight recovery, odd-size role flow, covering fire or HC migration proof
Living member retention is metadata, not preservation of every old buddy relationship or command authority
No whole Protocol source parity or measured performance claim
Unsigned dirty development preserves unrelated dirt; review/handover postdate package
